new.md:
Creates a `GtkScaleButton`.

The new scale button has a range between `min` and `max`,
with a stepping of `step`.

doc.brief: Provides a button which pops up a scale widget.
doc.md:
Provides a button which pops up a scale widget.

This kind of widget is commonly used for volume controls in multimedia
applications, and GTK provides a [`VolumeButton`](xref:gtk:Gtk.VolumeButton) subclass that
is tailored for this use case.

# Shortcuts and Gestures

The following signals have default keybindings:

- [`ScaleButton::popup`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ScaleButton#event:popup)

# CSS nodes

```
scalebutton.scale
╰── button.toggle
    ╰── <icon>
```

`GtkScaleButton` has a single CSS node with name scalebutton and `.scale`
style class, and contains a `button` node with a `.toggle` style class.

set_value.brief: Sets the current value of the scale.
set_value.md:
Sets the current value of the scale.

If the value is outside the minimum or maximum range values,
it will be clamped to fit inside them.

The scale button emits the [`ScaleButton::value-changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ScaleButton#event:value-changed)
signal if the value changes.

icons.brief: The names of the icons to be used by the scale button.
icons.md:
The names of the icons to be used by the scale button.

The first item in the array will be used in the button
when the current value is the lowest value, the second
item for the highest value. All the subsequent icons will
be used for all the other values, spread evenly over the
range of values.

If there's only one icon name in the `icons` array, it will
be used for all the values. If only two icon names are in
the `icons` array, the first one will be used for the bottom
50% of the scale, and the second one for the top 50%.

It is recommended to use at least 3 icons so that the
`GtkScaleButton` reflects the current value of the scale
better for the users.

popdown.md:
Emitted to dismiss the popup.

This is a [keybinding signal](class.SignalAction.html).

The default binding for this signal is <kbd>Escape</kbd>.

popup.brief: Emitted to popup the scale widget.
popup.md:
Emitted to popup the scale widget.

This is a [keybinding signal](class.SignalAction.html).

The default bindings for this signal are <kbd>Space</kbd>,
<kbd>Enter</kbd> and <kbd>Return</kbd>.

value-changed.brief: Emitted when the value field has changed.
value-changed.md: Emitted when the value field has changed.
